area: Area 2: BM25 extensions and keyword with vector in one query
current_formulation: BM25 mixes BM11 and BM15 through the parameter b and leaves k1 and b to be set by hand.

steps.formulation: BM1: the Robertson-Sparck Jones weight, with no term frequency or document length, used at TREC-1.
steps.quote: For TREC-1 [1] the "standard" Robertson-Sparck Jones weighting function was used for all runs (equation 1, see also [5]).

criticism.quote: This appears to be because the simple weighting scheme tends to favour long documents

steps.formulation: BM11 and BM15: 2-Poisson term weights with document length normalisation or correction, at TREC-2.
steps.quote: BM15: 2-Poisson termweights as equation 3 with document length correction as equation 5.

criticism.quote: The basis for BM11 was one of two possible models of document length (the "verbosity" hypothesis, [4]) which might be expected to exaggerate the document length effect; this is the justification for considering the mix.

steps.formulation: BM25 combines BM11 and BM15 into one function through the parameter b, at TREC-3.
steps.quote: we in effect combined BM11 and BM15 into a single function BM25

criticism.quote: Concerning the internal parameters, the model provides no guidance on how these should be set.
